name: Julieta Paredes
shortBio: Aymara-Bolivian decolonial feminist philosopher and co-founder of Feminismo Comunitario who theorized the "patriarchal junction" (entronque patriarcal) linking ancestral and colonial domination.
centralQuestion: How do women decolonize both Western neoliberalism and romanticized ancestral patriarchies through community feminism (feminismo comunitario)?

keyWorks.title: Hilando fino desde el feminismo comunitario
keyWorks.description: Foundational manifesto of Aymara community feminism proposing body-space-time-movement-memory as relational categories.
